description.content: Returns roles for the caller's organization. By default only org-scoped roles are returned. Pass `include=cluster` to also include cluster-wide roles (those with `organizationId == null`, e.g. super-admin and other system-actor roles); these are not assignable from the org UI but downstream consumers like the auth-context role lookup and the events page need them to resolve cluster-wide role IDs.

query.description: Set to `cluster` to additionally include cluster-wide roles (`organizationId == null`). Omit for org-scoped roles only.

Infrastructure inspection platform API. All endpoints are scoped to the authenticated organization via Bearer JWT or API key.
